calls.reason: CNBC shows the $40B round was the largest private tech raise ever. But the packet never puts a number on OpenAI's total need or compares it with the most any startup has raised overall, so the claim can't be settled.

The evidence is mixed. GPT-4.5 was costly to run, but ARC Prize's independent tests of o3 and OpenAI's own cost-performance figures show real gains. No source tracks gains against resources across successive models.
